Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to trash the top card of my security stack when this Digimon is already unsuspended?

Card Q&A.a: It means the total number of cards in both you and your opponent's security stacks. For example, if you have 3 cards in your security stack and your opponent has 2 cards in their security stack, the total security cards will be 5 cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "the total cards in both players' security stacks" in this card's inherited effect mean?

Effect: [When Digivolving] By trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, you may place 1 yellow card from your hand on top of your security stack.
